audit.why: Content chart Sion/Skill/Graves/Graves/Skill/Graves/Sion matches the packet exactly and matches the mirror, which reported the chart already correct and left it alone. Every why argues its own row.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 and first-item spikes name Collateral Damage and 'his first Ironspike Whip or Youmuu's' with no cooldown or timing anchor, so 'respect it' has nothing behind it.
audit.why: Collateral Damage is 100/80/60. At rank 1 that is a 100-second window in which his only burst answer to a Sion all-in is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this lane is absent from all eighteen fields: Graves's bullets cannot pass through units. Quickdraw's cooldown is also called 'short' four times without ever being given.
audit.why: Riot's passive text: 'Attacks fire 4 bullets, which cannot pass through units.' A minion standing between you and Graves eats the shot — the standard 'don't stand behind minions' instinct is exactly backwards here, and it is the cheapest counterplay in the matchup. Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12 and its cooldown drops when he lands basic attacks, so it is 16s at rank 1 but shorter in practice — both halves matter.
audit.corrected: Minion-blocking put into wants.you[1] and whys[2]; Quickdraw's 16s plus the auto-attack refund put into whys[1] and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Advice repeatedly says to commit 'when Quickdraw is down' without saying how long that is or that Graves shortens it himself.
audit.why: A window you cannot count is not a window. 16s at rank 1, cut by every landed auto.

edits.before: He has Quickdraw now and can dodge through your charge telegraph — only trade if his dash is on cooldown or wasted on a minion.
edits.after: Quickdraw is up and dodges your charge — 16s at rank 1, but his autos cut it down, so trade only in the beat after he burns it.

edits.before: Quickdraw armor stacking and free kite angles mean your charge telegraph is a liability; he punishes every slow channel with a full shotgun burst.
edits.after: Quickdraw armour stacks and he kites your telegraph freely; his bullets cannot pass through units, so the minion line is the only thing keeping his burst off you.

edits.before: Graves stacks Quickdraw armor and kites your charge telegraph freely — respect the dash window or you eat a full shotgun burst.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 and his autos shorten it further — charge Q in the beat after he dashes, or you eat a full shotgun burst.

edits.before: Graves's first Ironspike Whip or Youmuu's hits before Heartsteel stacks — his burst outpaces your unfinished HP pool.
edits.after: His first item lands before Heartsteel stacks and Collateral Damage is 100s at rank 1 — his burst outpaces your HP pool.

edits.before: Keep the wave on your side of lane to force him to walk into your charge telegraph range
edits.after: Keep a minion between you — his four bullets stop on the first unit and never reach you

edits.before: Stack Quickdraw armor and kite you during your W-shield detonation window
edits.after: Stack Quickdraw armour and kite through the 3 seconds before your W detonates

notes: spikes[1].text in the brief reads '...for nothing.' at the end of the packet excerpt but the currentText string ends '...shotgun burst.'; I copied the currentText version character-exact, which is the one measured against disk. No full-layer entry exists for sion vs graves (currentText.full is null) — one of the 92 missing full entries; the mirror rewrote six phase whys on Graves's side, and none of that work has a home on ours until the entry exists. Carried from the mirror as a repo-wide warning: Smoke Screen does NOT blind. It reduces sight range and slows on impact. Four fields on the Graves page claimed a blind; none of Sion's fields do, so nothing needed fixing here, but the claim may exist on other pages. End of the Line detonates on terrain, so he can shell you from behind a wall in the side lane — not currently stated anywhere, and there was no field short enough to add it without pushing another fact out.
